frozen_scope_origin: Frozen before this revision build. Inherits original prep/HANDOFF.md and r001 scope; only fold amplitude increased from 1.65 to 2.2 mm with keel contribution 18% to 30% for V-rib readability.
name: Rastellum comb-edged oyster · R. carinatum-informed fossil-form study
claim_scope: Original genus-level articulated fossil-form, informed by R. carinatum. Not a specimen replica; unseen valve thickness, exact hinge completion, full pairing, scale and colors are artistic inference.
geometry_profile: One closed continuous manifold shell, with two individually editable semantic valve vertex groups, unequal convex volumes, narrow closed recessed seam. No internal anatomy.

axes.origin: grounded display pose, not inferred life position

material_profile: Four original palette-only opaque, single-sided Principled materials; no textures

critical_criteria.requirement: Long tapered crescent shell, not a broad scallop, horn, coiled snail or symmetric leaf
Raised median keel across convex valve; no canoe-like central hollow from generated concept
Approximately ten deliberate low-poly primary groups diverge as V ribs from keel to both long margins; group count artistic, not specimen count
Continuous deeply zigzag complementary margin, no floating teeth or accidental gaps; narrow actual seam groove
Three-dimensional unequal valve volumes, not mirror-identical halves or relief plaque
One quiet terminal hinge region, no invented detailed hinge teeth/internal scars
Preserve fragmentary mould and right/left source conflict; no original-specimen paired shell or inferred exact dimensions, locality or color claims

source_constraints: Only metadata citations and original geometry/render output in candidate public projection. Private photos, papers and concept remain outside candidate.
No handedness assigned. Fig7 H/I RGF VR35/33 lacks beaks and is not a complete articulated specimen.
Full pair, reverse surface, exact thickness, hinge completion and color are declared artistic decisions.
coverage_justification: 24 azimuth frames plus canonical full-angle views, true underside, raised-keel top clay, end hinge and front closed-margin detail. Optional exact-export transparency is separate. Graphics/device and composed-scene stages remain unknown, not waived.

criteria.description: Current GLB format, source roundtrip, zero geometry errors, portable artifact and deterministic two rebuild checks.
Inspect canonical and all-around actual exported shell: crescent outline, convex keel, V ribs, closed serrated seam, unequal volumes, quiet hinge.
Preserve the explicit partial external-mould evidence, inconsistent valve-side text, unseen reverse/pairing/scale/color uncertainty. This is an original genus-level study, not specimen reproduction.
Deliver editable semantic source, GLB, deterministic source/config, views, private-source separation, declared units and budgets.
